scripts.build: node tools/artifact-build.ts prepare write && tsc -p .adoption-shell-build.json && node tools/artifact-build.ts finish write
scripts.build:check: node tools/artifact-build.ts prepare check && tsc -p .adoption-shell-build.json && node tools/artifact-build.ts finish check
